No problem; glad you found it useful. I have a thing with lists. I think I might have minor OCD or something. Other things I do lend me to believe this as well, such as having to top off my cereal with those last 4 flakes, after I've already put the box down, because it doesn't feel right otherwise. It's not enough without those 4 extra flakes of corn.

That could very well be. Human brains have a natural tendency to value order, and that can factor into listmaking as well. But specific compulsions can be an indicator of OCD. I have mild compulsions now, things like the need to end the last step of a staircase on the right foot or mentally arrange sets of spoken syllables into cadences of six. It used to be debilitating -- things like flicking a light switch off repeatedly until it feels "right" to do it, or walking back up and down the stairs until I did it the right way -- but I've got a much better handle on it nowadays, and it doesn't affect my life much anymore.

The thing that's interesting to me about OCD is that everyone asks what happens if you don't perform your compulsion. Oftentimes there simply isn't an "or else"; you simply feel compelled to do something, or redo something because it didn't feel right the first time.
